name: independent-eval
provenance: Curated by hand on 2026-10-29 for ROADMAP phase 36's independent eval gate. It is a tests/fixtures/retrieval-golden.json-style fixture (documents plus named expectations) extended with a per-case id, which is what dataset.leak_check needs to refuse shared identifiers. Every case's expectation comes from this fixture's own document text, written here and opened here at authoring time: each query's terms appear in exactly the document named by `expected` and in no other document in this file. No text is quoted from retrieval-golden.json, from any built dataset manifest, or from any source record under .brain-data; the disjointness that matters (eval vs training) is proved by tests/test_phase42_independent_eval_gate.py, which also ingests these documents and measures recall and MRR on them. Document origins carry the `fixture-independent:` prefix so they cannot collide with the `fixture:` origins of the golden set or with real import origins.
